disclaimer: Context only — an AI reading of the radar's own deterministic output, not a signal. It feeds no score or allocation, can be wrong or overconfident, and every claim cites the radar evidence it is based on. Graded against the tape over time; treat as odds, not a forecast.

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price, with a divergence z-score of 3.486 and fused acceleration of 1.879 across seven sources [P2][P3]. The signal has moderate breadth: congressional buying, lobbying, and news are positive, but federal contracts and pre-award solicitations remain negative, while grants and material events are only slightly positive [P3]. News is accelerating and entirely unscheduled, supporting near-term persistence, although the evidence does not establish that this pace will continue [P5]. Price confirmation is poor: 60-day relative strength is deeply negative, so the emerging narrative remains an activity-led divergence rather than a confirmed trend [P1][P4].
assessments.rationale_zh: 真实活动明显领先于价格，活动与价格的背离为3.486，七类来源的综合加速度为1.879 [P2][P3]。国会净买入、游说活动和新闻流为正，但联邦合同及招标前征询仍为负，拨款机会与重大事件的贡献也较弱 [P3]。新闻流正在加速且全部属于非预定事件，为短期延续提供支持，但现有证据无法证明这种速度能够长期维持 [P5]。过去60天的相对价格表现明显落后，因此目前仍是活动领先、价格尚未确认的早期阶段 [P1][P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related interest, lobbying and news activity are picking up, but actual federal contracts and early procurement activity remain soft. Prices have fallen well behind the market over the past 60 days, so investors have not yet validated the improving activity. Keep the theme on a watchlist until procurement measures strengthen or prices begin to respond.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关关注、游说活动和新闻热度正在上升，但联邦合同和早期采购活动仍然偏弱。过去60天，相关公司的价格表现明显落后于大盘，说明投资者尚未认可这些改善。现阶段更适合继续观察，等待采购指标增强或价格开始跟进。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish countercase is that the unusually large activity-price gap, combined with positive congressional buying, lobbying, and accelerating news, marks an emerging opportunity before prices catch up [P1][P2][P3][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the thesis if the next observation shows federal contracts and pre-award solicitations turning positive while fused acceleration remains positive and 60-day relative strength improves materially [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Reject the thesis if congressional buying, lobbying, and news acceleration roll over while contracts and solicitations remain negative, especially if relative price weakness persists [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: Space Economy

assessments.rationale: Real activity is meaningfully ahead of price (divergence z=1.783), led by a very strong regulatory pipeline (z=3.475) and pre-award solicitations (z=1.561), with additional positive but modest signals from congressional net buying and lobbying [P2][P3]. Persistence is plausible because several sources are contributing and fused acceleration is 2.178, but the theme is still forming; material 8-K events are negative, while grants and news flow show no acceleration [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity: 60-day relative strength is -11.34% versus the market, so the narrative remains an early divergence rather than an established trend [P4]. MONITOR is appropriate until procurement and regulatory momentum either broaden into company events, grants, or news, or price begins to confirm [P3][P4][P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 实际活动明显领先价格（背离值为1.783），主要由监管项目（3.475）和授标前采购（1.561）推动，国会议员净买入与游说活动也提供了较弱的正面信号 [P2][P3]。多个来源共同改善且综合加速度为2.178，说明趋势可能延续；但主题仍处于形成期，重大8-K事件为负，联邦资助和新闻流也没有加速 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未确认，过去60天相对大盘落后11.34%，因此目前更适合观察，而不是立即介入 [P4]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Regulatory activity and pre-award federal procurement are picking up, with smaller supportive signals from congressional buying and lobbying. However, company-reported material events are weakening, grants and news are not accelerating, and the group has lagged the market by about 11% over the past 60 days. The activity may be an early lead, but it is prudent to wait for broader real-world follow-through or a turn in price.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 监管推进和联邦采购的授标前活动正在升温，国会议员买入和游说活动也带来较弱的支持。不过，企业披露的重大事项正在转弱，联邦资助和新闻热度没有加速，而且相关公司过去60天落后大盘约11%。这些变化可能是早期信号，但更稳妥的做法是等待更多实际进展或价格转强。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bearish case is that the apparent momentum is concentrated in regulatory and pre-award indicators rather than realized grants or company-reported events; grants are flat, material 8-K activity is negative, news acceleration is zero, and price is underperforming [P3][P4][P5].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if subsequent readings show continued positive pre-award and regulatory activity alongside improvement in grants or material 8-K events, with 60-day relative strength turning positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if regulatory and pre-award signals retreat while grants remain flat, material 8-K events stay negative, and relative price performance continues to deteriorate [P3][P4].

assessments.name: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
assessments.name_zh: 半导体设备（晶圆厂设备）

assessments.rationale: Real activity is strong and broad: government contracts are the largest positive contributor (z=1.977), lobbying is also elevated (z=1.107), and congressional net buying is positive (z=0.664), while material 8-K events are essentially neutral (z=-0.065); fused acceleration is 1.695 across four sources [P3]. Persistence is plausible but not established because the signal is multi-source and accelerating [P3], yet the lifecycle is only forming [P1] and there is no supporting news leg [P5]. Price offers modest confirmation through positive 60-day relative strength of 0.0762, but its direction reading is neutral [P4], while activity remains ahead of price by 0.709 [P2]. This supports MONITOR rather than ENTER until either price confirmation strengthens or another observation demonstrates persistence.
assessments.rationale_zh: 现实活动信号较强且来源较广：政府合同贡献最大（z=1.977），游说活动也明显上升（z=1.107），国会净买入为正（z=0.664），而重大8-K事件基本中性（z=-0.065）；四个来源的综合加速度为1.695 [P3]。这些活动可能持续，但尚未得到充分证明，因为信号虽来自多个来源并在加速 [P3]，目前仍处于形成初期 [P1]，且没有新闻面的支持 [P5]。过去60天的相对表现为正，提供了有限的价格确认，但方向读数仍为中性 [P4]，同时现实活动领先价格0.709 [P2]。因此更适合继续观察，等待价格确认增强或后续数据证明活动能够持续。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, lobbying activity, and congressional buying are all picking up, while corporate event filings are roughly flat. Prices have begun to outperform the broader market, but only modestly, so they have not fully caught up with the improvement in real-world activity. The signal is promising but still young and lacks support from news flow, making this a theme to watch rather than act on immediately.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、游说活动和国会买入都在升温，而企业重大事项申报大致持平。相关股票的表现已开始超过大盘，但幅度不大，价格尚未完全反映现实活动的改善。这个趋势颇有潜力，但仍处于早期且缺少新闻支持，因此目前更适合观察，而不是立即行动。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that three independent activity sources are positive, including a particularly strong government-contract signal, and their combined acceleration is high [P3]; because activity is already ahead of price [P2], waiting for stronger price confirmation could surrender the earliest part of the move.

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the thesis if the next observation shows activity still accelerating across multiple sources [P3] and 60-day relative strength turns decisively positive rather than retaining a neutral direction reading [P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it if government contracts and lobbying lose their positive momentum [P3], the activity-price divergence closes through weakening activity rather than rising price [P2], or relative performance turns negative [P4].

assessments.name: Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight)

assessments.rationale: The current activity signal is mixed: congressional net buying is notably positive and the combined acceleration measure is strong, but lobbying, federal grant opportunities, material 8-K events, and especially news flow are weak or negative [P3]. Durability is uncertain because the theme is only forming, activity is not improving across multiple independent sources, and news velocity is decelerating despite being entirely unscheduled [P1][P3][P5]. Price has not confirmed the activity lead: the activity-price divergence is modestly positive while 60-day relative performance versus the market is negative [P2][P4]. MONITOR rather than enter until either federal and corporate activity broaden or price begins to confirm.
assessments.rationale_zh: 当前活动信号好坏参半：国会议员净买入明显偏强，综合加速指标也较高，但游说活动、联邦拨款机会、重大公司事件和新闻流均偏弱，其中新闻流下滑最明显 [P3]。持续性仍不确定，因为主题尚处早期，多个独立来源并未同步改善，而且新闻传播正在减速，尽管新闻全部属于非预定事件 [P1][P3][P5]。价格尚未确认活动领先：现实活动仅温和领先价格，近60日相对大盘表现仍为负 [P2][P4]。因此目前应继续观察，等待政府与企业活动更广泛回升，或价格开始跟进。
assessments.rationale_plain: Congressional buying related to AI-chip companies is picking up, but lobbying, federal funding opportunities, major company disclosures, and news activity are not strengthening alongside it. Share prices have also lagged the market over the past 60 days, so the real-world signs have not yet translated into investor momentum. Keep watching rather than buying now, and wait for activity to spread across more channels or for prices to begin confirming the improvement.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 与人工智能芯片公司相关的国会议员买入正在增加，但游说活动、联邦资金机会、重大公司披露和新闻热度并未同步增强。过去60天相关股票的表现也落后于大盘，说明现实活动尚未转化为投资者动能。目前宜继续观察，等待更多渠道共同回升，或价格开始确认改善。
assessments.dissent: The strongest bullish counterargument is that the combined activity acceleration is strong, congressional net buying is elevated, and activity is already ahead of price while the covered group has underperformed the market—conditions that could precede a catch-up move [P2][P3][P4][P6].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm the MONITOR stance if the next reading still shows negative or weak lobbying, grant, corporate-event, and news signals, while 60-day relative performance remains below the market [P3][P4][P5].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm it in favor of ENTER if several currently weak sources turn positive—particularly lobbying, grants, material corporate events, and news acceleration—while relative price performance also turns positive [P3][P4][P5].

assessments.name: AI Semiconductors

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all three observed sources: Congress net buying is below trend (z=-0.551), lobbying has contracted sharply (z=-3.5), and material 8-K events are also below trend (z=-0.635) [P3]. The theme is classified as fading, with activity substantially lagging price (divergence z=-2.597) [P1][P2]. Meanwhile, miners have outperformed the market over 60 days, so price appears to be running ahead of the underlying activity rather than confirming a durable pickup [P4]. There is no news leg to broaden or refresh the narrative [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 三类现实活动均偏弱：国会议员净买入低于趋势，游说活动明显收缩，重大8-K事件也低于趋势[P3]。该主题已进入衰退阶段，现实活动显著落后于价格[P1][P2]。与此同时，相关矿业股过去60天跑赢大盘，说明价格更可能领先于基本活动，而非确认持续改善[P4]。目前也没有新闻推动力来扩展或延续这一叙事[P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government-related buying, lobbying activity, and company-reported material events are all running below their recent norms, with lobbying showing the sharpest slowdown. Silver miners have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so prices appear to have moved ahead of the activity supporting the story. With no fresh news support, investors should avoid chasing the move unless real-world activity begins to recover.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府相关买入、游说活动和企业披露的重大事件都低于近期常态，其中游说活动降温最明显。尽管如此，白银矿业股过去60天仍跑赢大盘，说明价格可能已经领先于支撑这一故事的现实活动。目前也缺少新的新闻推动，投资者不宜追涨，除非相关活动开始恢复。
assessments.dissent: The strongest countercase is that the positive fused acceleration across three sources may be an early inflection, while positive 60-day relative strength could be anticipating that recovery [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Confirm AVOID if the next observation still shows all three activity sources below trend, especially continued severe lobbying weakness, while relative price strength remains positive [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: Disconfirm AVOID if lobbying, congressional buying, and material-event activity turn broadly positive across multiple observations and activity begins to lead rather than lag price [P2][P3].

assessments.name: Silver Miners

assessments.rationale: Real activity is weak across all four tracked sources: government contracts (-1.357), congressional net buying (-1.281), lobbying (-0.979), and material corporate events (-0.252) are below trend [P3]. Although fused acceleration is modestly positive at 0.383 [P3], the theme is classified as fading with activity materially behind price (divergence z=-2.23) [P1][P2]. Meanwhile, 60-day relative price strength is positive, indicating that market performance has run ahead of the underlying signals [P4]. With no supporting news leg, there is no additional catalyst evidence in the pack [P5].
assessments.rationale_zh: 四类跟踪信号均低于常态：政府合同、国会议员净买入、游说活动和重大公司事件都偏弱[P3]。尽管综合活动的短期变化略有改善[P3]，整体趋势仍在消退，实体活动明显落后于价格[P1][P2]。过去60天相对市场表现较强，说明价格已经跑在基本活动之前[P4]；同时没有新闻催化支持[P5]。
assessments.rationale_plain: Government contracting, congressional buying, lobbying and major corporate announcements are all running below their usual pace, despite a small recent improvement in the combined activity trend. Share prices have nevertheless outperformed the market over the past 60 days, so enthusiasm appears to be running ahead of observable activity. With no supporting news catalyst, investors should avoid chasing the move until real-world activity improves across several channels.
assessments.rationale_plain_zh: 政府合同、国会议员买入、游说活动和企业重大公告目前都低于通常水平，尽管综合活动近期略有改善。相关公司股价过去60天跑赢大盘，市场热情似乎已经领先于实际活动。由于缺少新闻催化，投资者不宜追高，应等待多项现实活动同步回升。
assessments.dissent: The strongest counterargument is that the modest positive turn in combined activity could mark an early inflection, while strong 60-day relative performance may be anticipating that recovery [P3][P4].

falsifiable_check.confirm: Upgrade the view if the next readings show several of the four activity sources turning positive together while combined acceleration remains positive and price strength persists [P3][P4].
falsifiable_check.disconfirm: The avoid stance is reinforced if government contracts, congressional buying and lobbying remain below trend or deteriorate further while relative price strength stays positive, widening the activity-price gap [P2][P3][P4].

assessments.name: Big Pharma

rotation.summary: Leadership is rotating toward activity-led Space Economy, semiconductor/AI chip equipment, and Staples, while Cybersecurity is the lone mature confirmed-up leader; energy, health, nuclear, memory, megacap tech, and crypto are fading or confirmed down.
rotation.summary_zh: 领导力正转向由实际活动领先的太空经济、半导体设备/AI芯片及必需消费；网络安全是唯一成熟且已确认上行的主线，而能源、医疗、核能、存储、科技巨头与加密资产正在衰退或已确认下行。
accumulate: Space Economy — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, emerging: activity leads price in an early lifecycle.
Semiconductor Equipment (WFE) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price as leadership develops.
AI Semiconductors — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price as the trend forms.
Consumer Staples (Equal-Weight) — POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE, forming: activity leads price, signaling defensive participation.
reduce: Silver Miners — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price is ahead of weakening activity.
Big Pharma — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price support lacks activity confirmation.
Insurance & Brokers — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: activity is not confirming price.
GLP-1 & Obesity — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price is outrunning activity.
US Energy Complex — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: leadership is losing activity support.
Health Care (Equal-Weight) — NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE, fading: price lacks real-activity confirmation.
AI Neoclouds & HPC Hosting — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading.
Critical Minerals & Rare Earths — CONFIRMED_DOWN, fading.
watch: Whether Space Economy, Semiconductor Equipment, AI Semiconductors, or Staples advance from POSITIVE_DIVERGENCE to CONFIRMED_UP.
Whether mature Cybersecurity retains CONFIRMED_UP or begins diverging negatively.
Whether fading NEGATIVE_DIVERGENCE themes regain activity confirmation before price weakens further.
Whether quiet AI infrastructure, data-center power, grid buildout, industrial capex, or defense themes develop positive divergence.
Whether confirmed-down nuclear, uranium, memory, megacap tech, and crypto stabilize and transition out of fading lifecycles.
